10x10 Pop-Up Tent

Quick Shade, Easy Cover

Our 10 ft x 10 ft white pop-up canopy tent is a fast, simple way to add shade or light cover to your event. It works well over food tables, welcome tables, prize tables, small vendor setups, and backyard seating areas.

The rental is $175. Add setup and takedown by our team for an optional $50, or set it up yourself. Weight bags for anchoring are included with every rental, and delivery is quoted separately.

This is an open-sided canopy, not an enclosed event tent. The tent must stay anchored at all times and must not be used in winds above 38 km/h, storms, or unsafe weather. Final availability, delivery, and setup suitability are confirmed manually before booking.
